The [[Prax Arms/Legends|Prax Arms]] '''Protector PRP-500 Hold-Out Dart Pistol''' was a palm-sized personal defense weapon. Since it required no [[power cell]]s or energy emitters, it could be easily concealed from scanning equipment.<ref name="GFT" />

Prax Protectors were favored by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
